title: Agents in Business Central – part 2 – the prompt
summary: Building effective agents in Business Central requires well-structured prompts with clear responsibilities, guidelines, and task instructions. The post explains how to use memory, page-specific instructions, and conditional logic to guide agent behavior reliably and keep humans in control.
key_points: Agent instructions need three core components: responsibilities (scope and boundaries), guidelines (rulebook for behavior), and task instructions (concrete procedural steps)
Agents should ask for help when data is missing or unclear, and request user review for important steps to maintain human oversight
Agents can memorize specific actions, search results, and explicitly instructed values, but not the full state of every page
Use page-specific instructions with conditional logic to provide detailed guidance only when needed and improve performance
Business Central agents have context-aware tools like searching pages, selecting rows, executing actions, and setting field values
